purpose: v0.2 expression sheet for the canon bunny (hero 2→3 on the ADOPT scorecard): frame-coherent expression variants of the promoted idle master for blink / ear-twitch / chomp cycle / happy joy. render.js swaps frames per FSM signal; nothing else in the scene changes.
style_reference_note: Reference image = the picked canon character (assets/character/rabbit-idle.png source: art/calibration/bunny-style-options/generations/round-003/r3-fullbody-flat-matte.png). EVERY option must keep the character at the identical position, scale, pose, proportions, outline weight, and palette in the 1024x1024 frame, with the same solid flat background (border flood-fill keyed at runtime; keep it perfectly uniform). Single change per option — see prompts.
acceptance_criteria: Content bounding box within ~6 px (1024-scale) of the idle master's (centroid/bbox pixel-probe at critique)
Palette match: warm brown outlines + fur whites + bow/blush pinks sampled against the master
Background stays a uniform flat keyable solid (no gradients, shadows, or added elements)
The single expression change is present and legible at game render scale (~378 px tall)
No text, no watermark, no new objects/characters; matte flat style unchanged
